# G05 R2 — conservative lower stores and actual Asahi consumption

**Scoped decision: park the tested lower-only128 hierarchy; broad G05 remains OPEN.** A changed, conservative narrowed implementation now has a bit-level proof, actual Asahi store evidence and actual game consumption/trace evidence. It has no reliable measured gain. The required contrasting pose adds roughly3.93M net query expressions before construction, versus about0.47M removed at pose2. This is an opportunity decision to decline a long cost cohort, not a physical slowdown theorem or exhaustion of hierarchy designs. All11OPEN/0closed/defaultOff.

## Changed implementation and proof

The [proof](PROOF.md) defines Q: depths below2^-14 become0; valid larger FP32 depths have their low13 fraction bits cleared. Invalid/nonfinite/out-of-range inputs produce lower0/noncertificate under the consumer's nonnegative march guard. Q emits zero or a normal exactly representable binary16 value. It does not depend on the inexact half rounding mode that invalidated the previous CPU prediction. All4/4/4/2 stores use Q and unused upper1. Induction over actual valid children and logical odd extents preserves lower<=every valid native descendant. Idempotence prevents accumulated loss across stores. Absolute slack<2^-11 for depths<1 above threshold; below threshold slack<2^-14. This is lower-only, not exact minmax.

The private constructor adds bitcast/comparison/AND/selection ALU per output texel. It retains all four draws, the full-resolution first read, intermediate reads/writes, finalstores, all native depth ownership/sampler/border/repair guards and CPU/state costs. Scratch allocations at2560x1600 are1,088,000B instead of2,176,000B; these are logical bytes, not transactions or measured bandwidth. Final20x13 narrowing alone saves only1040B and was not pursued separately.

[Actual store data](lower-store-result.json) contains106,191 input texels, all normal-half boundaries and FP32 adjacent/midpoint values, near0/1/subnormal/invalid values and seeded bit patterns. The individual render-store, repeated idempotent store, and odd513x207→129x52→33x13→9x4→5x2 reductions have zero mismatches. Raw input bits, actual linked fragment and RG32 readback bytes are retained. Apple M1 G13G B1/Mesa25.1.0-asahi20250221 is actual. This finite stress is separate from the universal arithmetic argument and from Minecraft trace evidence. [Five focused proof checks](focused-tests.log) passed. No conservativeness counterexample occurred.

## Actual private consumer

[Source/build/archive joins](source-build-archive-joins.json), [linked-source joins](linked-source-joins.json), [actual JVM and expanded argfiles](actual-jvm.json), and [complete producer receipt](quality/build-binding.json) bind the new archives and current classes/resources. Two offline JDK21 producer builds succeeded. The explicit private lowerAsahiR2 property, exact Linux/aarch64/M1/driver/API checks, NeoForge21.1.253, native options and pinned artifact set are separate from the old Mac qualification. The shader guard uses actual MC_OS_LINUX, not Mac spoofing. Public adapters/defaults were not widened.

Actual MC1.21.1/NF21.1.253/Iris1.8.12-local/Sodium0.6.13, native100/AA2/AO/options, OW/noDH/noVOXY,2560x1600/RD12/fullscreen/VSyncOff were checked. Vanilla/mod resources only; no material staging or scene change. Both exact authored poses/day6000 were required: pose2(.5,71,82.5,yaw0,pitch9), pose3(.5,66,117.5,yaw0,pitch-3). No profile/world generation or ad hoc copies.

At each variant/pose the [actual copied-depth readback](actual-work-trace-summary.json) checked all260 native128 tiles against their descendant native depths and Q. Four checks had zero mismatches, matching copied/current frame, pipeline owner, copied depth, effective extent, native depth unit5 and sampler0. The existing constructor-owned separate depthtex1 after authentic depthtex0 copy remains; no depth0/depth1 substitution. Source/API pins alone are not admission: the linked translucent shader and live bound program/permission/readback establish this scoped consumption.

Forcedfalse and active each have two actual same-fragment native/candidate finalXYZ/infinite observations at each pose; all observed mismatch/trace-mismatch counts are zero, with equality treating unordered values as failures. The native ten-step recurrence, terminal native read and exact predecessor repair remain. NativeRGB witness instrumentation changes compilation and is not ordinary lean quality or timing.

| Active witness | Covered trace pixels | Saved native depth expressions | Bound expressions | Exact predecessor repairs | Net removed expressions |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| pose2 sample1 |262141|1217011|730003|17436|469572|
| pose2 sample2 |261546|1211048|727607|17496|465945|
| pose3 sample1 |2036249|6961095|9643181|1251931|-3934017|
| pose3 sample2 |2036249|6963994|9649861|1249402|-3935269|

Forcedfalse covered261546–262141 pixels at pose2 and2035642 at pose3, with zero saved/bound/repair counters and zero mismatch. Main bank has actual coverage; alt is retained with zero eligible pixels. Active certificates are nonzero in both views. [Full raw actual vectors/counts/receipts](quality/summary.json) retain the evidence, not just these totals. Counts describe visible-fragment query expressions; they do not establish native total tap counts, hardware transactions, overdraw or physical cost.

## Ordinary lean quality and cost decision

[Lean evidence](lean-quality.json) has eight ordinary stills and eight complete20s camera motions: native/forcedfalse/active/native-return at both poses, separate from the nativeRGB witness. [Contact sheet](lean-contact.png) plus24 source PNGs retain water, underwater glass, near solid/plank/wall edges and distant tree/waterfall silhouettes. Direct inspection found no gross candidate-specific discontinuity. Asynchronous5s/13s motion samples have slightly differing camera/wave/TAA phases; sparse captured frames are not fullvideo or exhaustive proof against temporal shimmer/thin-edge defects. No image tolerance or new floating-approximation waiver was applied. DH/PBR/public lifecycle remain unqualified.

**No hot comparison was acquired.** The actual contrasting view requires about3.93M extra query expressions, versus0.47M removed in the favorable view, before charging full-depth construction and new producer ALU. This weakens the practical premise across the two prescribed views enough to park the current design. A tiny cached hierarchy read can differ physically from a depth read, so this does not prove negative GPU cost or rule out a measured win. Historical Mac timings/drift are retained as history, not current Asahi evidence. No startup/frame-status timing, untimed forcedfalse or expression arithmetic is used to attribute overhead or claim performance. The diagnostic native arm still builds the producer, so it is not a producer-free economic primary.

A reliable gain is explicitly UNTESTED; no frozen primary cohort or analysis is fabricated. Any later economic test would need native with producer absent versus corrected active with the complete producer+consumer charged, prospectively frozen protocol and complete valid total-frame cohort, with diagnostics omitted from gain windows. Reopening unchanged timing without a more persuasive construction/consumer premise is not recommended. [Finite avenues](AVENUES.md) preserve unresolved sparse/demand/spatial designs and other tuples; none is declared exhausted.

## Operation, restoration and storage

The [prospective budget](operation-budget.json) allocated1360s for all science arms within1500s science+300s recovery/1800s watchdog. Actual total operation was411.63s including18.28s startup,39.04s initial scene/warmup and20.52s restoration/release. These are operational costs, not optimization timings. No benchmark windows, concurrent source edits/builds/tests/encoders during measured windows, long speculative trial, retries, commits, pushes, paid resources, PC/C02, global STATUS/goal/settings changes or delegates occurred.

[FINAL-RESTORATION](FINAL-RESTORATION.json) follows one fail-closed sequence: terminal complete/restored/released operation; exact own process birth/argv absence; no clients; lane/save locks free; full canonical maps unchanged; full pool original config/options maps checked with individually manifested additions; new backup byte-preserved outside pool; only then common checked checkout; full postreset world/config/options/lock verification. The generated backup is known-identical, but still preserved in [manifest](backup-manifest.json). No old-inode recovery after reset. No live custody transfer; missing p-stack auth retained without invented grant/repair.

[Storage-steward](storage-steward.json) retains useful results, small private archives, shared compiled outputs and canonical managed slot. No disposable substantial artifact or unowned/shared process was deleted. [Errors/limits](ERRORS-LIMITATIONS.md) and [review guide](REVIEW-GUIDE.md) distinguish proof, functional private port, scoped trace/lean evidence, unmeasured economics and parking. Root owns new independent Astra high/Sol xhigh reviews and actual debate; this worker does not close campaign items.

# G05 R2 review guide

Read REPORT first. This packet proposes scoped parking of the current conservative lower-only4/4/4/2 consumer; it does not close broad G05 or claim a speed loss.

1. Check PROOF.md and the common correction in scripts/check_makeup_hierarchy_lower.py / DepthHierarchyR50.java. The quantizer emits only zero or normal exactly representable half values, not inexact nearest-half conversion. Verify unsigned invalid classification, all-stage induction, odd-edge logical extents, absorbing invalid0 and nonnegative march guard. Unused upper1 is not an exact upper minmax.
2. Read lower-store-result.json: raw input bits, fragment source, exact actual GL identity, six stages of raw RG32 readback and comparisons. Stage0/1 isolate individual stores and idempotence; later stages test odd-edge reductions. CPU proof checks do not substitute for these actual stores.
3. Read actual-work-trace-summary.json and quality/summary.json. Both fixed poses and both actual image banks are retained. Verify nonzero main coverage, active saved counts, forcedfalse zero counts, same-fragment finalXYZ/infinite zero mismatch and actual first-pixel vectors. Verify260 copied-depth tiles per check and matching owner/pipeline/copy/current frame/native sampler0/depth unit/extent. Source-build-archive-joins.json points to actual linked graph sources, actual JVM/argfiles, options/version tuples and complete producer receipt. Do not infer hardware transactions or trace correctness from pins alone.
4. Read lean-quality.json/contact sheet and source PNGs: ordinary native/false/active/return eight stills and eight20s motions, separate from nativeRGB diagnostic. Sparse stills during motion are bounded visual evidence, not fullvideo or exhaustive thin-edge/DH/PBR qualification.
5. Challenge the opportunity decision: pose2 ~466–470k expressions removed; pose3 ~3.934–3.935M added before producer. Four construction draws and all original reads/writes/guards remain. A small cached hierarchy fetch and a depth fetch need not cost the same. No matched total-frame cohort was acquired and no slowdown or overhead attribution is asserted. Long timing is declined because this candidate has no persuasive whole-objective opportunity across the two required views, not because counts prove impossibility.
6. FINAL-RESTORATION.json links terminal operations, exact process-birth/argv absence, full canonical maps, preserved per-file uncertain backups outside pool, checked checkout and complete postreset maps/locks. storage-steward.json retains useful evidence/shared caches.

Root owns the requested new independent Astra high/Sol xhigh reviews and actual debate. No reviewer was launched here. All11OPEN/0closed/defaultOff; public lifecycle, DH/PBR and reliable gain remain unqualified. Reopen for a concrete changed producer/certificate consumer design, not unchanged timing retries or sourcehash-only admission.
